perspectiveValidation.characters: redrawn from a shared orthographic camera and pose guide; visually reviewed

layout: Each character occupies two rows: 6 standing views, 6 seated views and 1 profile on the first; 4 walking frames in each of 4 directions on the second. Empty cells are transparent.
notes: Room wall/floor corner coordinates use a shared true-isometric projection. Rectangular furniture dominant structural axes have been aligned to +/-30 degrees.
Character art follows the common camera guide; painted anatomy remains an illustration rather than a parametric 3D model.
Profile circles retain their designed internal fills; outside pixels are transparent.
Scale normalization is an illustration convention, not a measurement of real objects.
Walking sheets contain four requested gait phases in four isometric directions; raster animation quality should be reviewed in motion.
